findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.aeogeo.site" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plan_audit, scan_url, export_report · Private data: fetch_sample_rules, export_report · Public sink: export_report · Destructive: plan_audit, scan_url, export_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plan_audit, scan_url, export_report · Private data: fetch_sample_rules, export_report · Public sink: export_report · Destructive: plan_audit, scan_url, export_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
